caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden statue standing on a rectangular, dark brown base. The statue represents a human figure with medium-brown skin and black hair, wearing a blue tunic with yellow trim and a greenish-yellow belt. The figure has a brown band or sash draped over its left shoulder. On its head, the figure wears a headdress consisting of blue and yellow colors with feather-like extensions. The statue’s right hand is bent to rest at its waist while the left hand holds an indistinct brown object, possibly a bundle or pouch. The wooden base is depicted with visible grain and metal fastenings. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, placing full emphasis on the statue and base. The colors used in the drawing are mainly muted: blue, brown, yellow, gray, and green, with some detailing in the headdress and tunic trim. The style is realistic, showing shading and worn areas on the statue.
title: Cigar Store Indian
